messages:
Ana (ML): quick sweep — vermilion-7b landed in staging this morning. need owners for: licensing check, perf profile, and canary plan. tagging folks.
Miguel: I can take perf profiling. will run end-to-end latency + memory sweep on g4dn and a100 variants. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya L: I can do initial license review. quick note: repo shows MIT-ish header but dependent tokenizer has a CC-BY file. pinging @LegalBot for confirmation.
LegalBot: automated scan: detected third_party tokenizers/cc-by-4.0.txt. Action: manual review required for derivative redistribution. Please attach the tokenizer source and usage notes.
Chris R: FYI infra dependency — vermilion requires hf-transformers >=4.32 and a custom kernel shim. Kevin in eng-runtime flagged the shim as a potential blocker for dedicated pools.
Ana (ML): thanks. Miguel — can you include perf numbers for both float16 and q4_0? we need guidance for default quantization in catalog.
Miguel: will do. rough plan: microbench (lm-perf style) for seq len [64,256,1024], batch [1,8,32], and KV cache reuse scenarios.
Sam P: code review ping — there's a small change in model-manifests: adding vermilion metadata. @Chris R could you glance? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-manifests/pull/142
Chris R: assigning to me. quick skim — manifest schema ok but we need an explicit fallback_model field for pre-quantized variants. request small change.
Eva D: ops note — canary plan suggestion: start in hosted with 5 tokens/sec cap, telemetry hooks for token-level latency and hallucination-score metric. If legal allows, we can default to hosted beta.
Priya L: attaching notes from the tokenizer owner: "tokenizer derived from open dataset, attribution required, commercial use allowed" — still need Legal final signoff.
LegalBot: manual review requested by @Priya L. Legal reviewer: @Sam P? please confirm next steps.
Sam P: I can loop in legal-team. timeline: can do signoff by Thu if no other third-party clauses appear.
Ana (ML): ownership matrix proposal: perf -> Miguel, licensing -> Priya + legal, infra compat -> Chris, canary/runbook -> Eva, manifest + QA -> Sam. agree?
Miguel: yes
Priya L: yes
Chris R: ok
Eva D: OK, will draft canary runbook and post by tomorrow morning.
Sam P: I'll land the manifest PR after manifest tweak, and gate on legal signoff + perf profile posted to /internal/model-profiles.
Ana (ML): one more ask — small eval set for safety/perf regression. can someone create a 50-prompt smoke-suite? maybe @Miguel + @Eva?
Miguel: will create perf-focused prompts; Eva can add safety checks.
Eva D: yep, will add safety prompts and a short runbook snippet to reproduce.
Ana (ML): perfect. I'll track in the catalog board and update owners. tagging for visibility: @LegalBot @Chris R @Miguel @Priya L @Eva D @Sam P. :thumbsup:
